sources.status: READ FIRST-HAND, AND DELIBERATELY NOT QUOTED
sources.why_not_quoted: The PDF's font encoding maps punctuation and digits onto other glyphs in text extraction: a full stop comes out as '4', a comma as '3' or ':' or '8', and 'fi' as '/'. Letters survive; punctuation does not. A character-exact quotation could therefore not be guaranteed true to the page, so none is taken and nothing on the page rests on one.
sources.checkable_observation: In the extracted text the word 'metamorphic' occurs 12 times and the word 'relation' occurs 0 times. The term 'metamorphic relation', universally attributed to this report, does not appear in it. Since the extraction corrupts punctuation rather than letters, a letters-only word would have survived. Offered as a checkable reading of this file, not as a claim about every edition.

sources.title: A Survey on Metamorphic Testing
sources.where: IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 42(9):805-824, September 2016
sources.version: author's accepted version, White Rose Research Online

quotations.q: Metamorphic testing [5] is a technique conceived to alleviate the oracle problem. It is based on the idea that often it is simpler to reason about relations between outputs of a program, than it is to fully understand or formalise its input-output behaviour.
a metamorphic relation for a function f is expressed as a relation among a series of function inputs x1, x2, . . . , xn (with n > 1), and their corresponding output values f(x1), f(x2), . . . , f(xn)
quotations.role: the definition this session's eight relations instantiate, each as an equality

quotations.q: an invariant has to hold for every possible program execution, whereas a metamorphic relation is a relation between different executions
quotations.role: why this is not the fixture testing of 2026-09-18

quotations.q: If the relation R does not hold on a pair of source and follow-up test cases x1 and x2, then a fault has been detected.
quotations.role: the inference this session tested and found too strong: 967 of 1,134 violations were the oracle's fault, not the rule's

sources.title: Bug or not Bug? Analysing the Reasons Behind Metamorphic Relation Violations

quotations.q: deciding if the MR is being violated due to a bug or because the MR does not hold/fit for particular conditions generated by specific inputs remains a manual task and unexplored
quotations.role: this session's adjudication step is the known manual step of the method, not an innovation of ours

quotations.q: If a particular MR is violated for at least one test input (and its change), there is a high probability that the SUT has a fault. On the other hand, if a particular MR is not violated, it does not guarantee that the SUT is fault free.
quotations.role: the asymmetry: M3, M4, M7 and M8 returning zero acquits nothing
